observer: Observe the logger name behind the INFO output stream for a caller-relative short name and for an explicit full name.
basis: The registered developer test requires the calling class name as the prefix for short logger names. A name containing package separators already specifies the logger. Both original POMs select logback-classic 1.1.2 for the registered test, including its logback-core dependency. That backend is fixed across the two runs. With the production API alone the old and new versions both used NOP.
